name: Finance Desk
description: AI stock research briefs, live charts, paper trading and a leaderboard shared by Möbius players.
author: IbrahimELE, mfehric

store.tagline: AI stock briefs, live charts and a paper-trading league with other Möbius players.
store.description:
Type a ticker and Finance Desk pulls the live price, the key financials and the risk section of the company's latest annual report (10-K). An AI analyst turns it into a short brief, and every claim links to Yahoo Finance or the SEC filing so you can check it.

Practise with $100,000 of virtual money: place market, limit and stop-loss orders at live prices, follow your positions and set price alerts on your watchlist. Open limit and stop-loss orders fill automatically when their price is reached, even while the app is closed. Don't know a ticker? Browse today's most active stocks, top gainers and losers, sectors and crypto.

Join the shared leaderboard to compete with other Möbius players under your @handle. One trading panel switches between Practice and Competition. Your competition account is separate from your practice workspaces, orders fill at the host's price and there are no resets. Players are ranked by money made per day, week and month.

AI briefs use your own Möbius AI model. Market data comes from Yahoo Finance and SEC EDGAR, so an internet connection is required. Virtual money only, not investment advice.
